text:
maria: Heads-up: our embeddings/rerank endpoint shows a performance regression after yesterday's runtime kernel switch. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/vec/embedding-kpis?orgId=1

sam: saw that. QPS is flat but p95 token latency jumped. do we have KV hit rates?

maria: QPS ~110 steady -> no traffic change. p95 token latency 78ms -> 140ms. KV hit dropped 92% -> 67% on v1 GPU pool.

jin: that smells like a cache key mismatch or different cache sharding with the new kernel. any denied kv ops in logs?

maria: grep of recent logs shows more KV-miss churn, e.g.:
```
[2026-03-17T21:05:12Z] rerank: kv_get miss key=ctx_12f8 shards=4->3
[2026-03-17T21:05:12Z] runtime: kernel=v1.3.0-optimized fallback=false
```

elaine: also noticed batching tail increase. mean batch size down but tail of 64 spikes. could be batching heuristic interacting with kernel's kernel_select path.

sam: is kernel_select toggling to a slower matmul path for certain seq_len or dim? profile snapshot?

maria: uploaded a flamegraph to the perf bucket and a short perf sample:
```
# cpu ms breakdown (sample):
- attention_kernel_select  42%
- kv_cache_lookup         18%
- memcpy/repack           15%
- fast_kernel_matmul      10%
- other                   15%
```

maria: attention_kernel_select is taking longer with new heuristics (checking more kernels, extra warmup).

david: ops-bot shows last deploy: runtime:v1.3.0 at 2026-03-17T20:55:00Z 
ops-bot: Deployment runtime:v1.3.0 to pool gpu-pool-us-west completed by @david :white_check_mark:

jin: quick mitigation: can we route rerank traffic to v1.2 hotfix pool? or enable kernel_select short-circuit?

elsine: (typo) meant elaine: i can flip the routing rule for canary to fallback pool, low friction.

sam: before rollback, can we add token-level latency breakdown in PromQL so we can tell which phase is slow (embed, kv, attention)? propose adding these series:
- rerank_token:latency:mean{phase="embed"}
- rerank_token:latency:mean{phase="kv_lookup"}
- rerank_token:latency:mean{phase="attn_kernel"}

maria: added dashboard tile on the fly and linked to panel id=7. current split shows attn_kernel spiking at p95. kv_lookup also up but less.

jin: hypothesis: kernel_select introduced extra per-request kernel probing cost when seq_len < threshold, because it probes int8 kernels with simulated run to pick best. that overhead kills small batches.

david: any config toggles in runtime? iirc there's an env KERNEL_PROBE_WINDOW and PROBE_SAMPLE_RATE.

maria: yes. KERNEL_PROBE_WINDOW=1024, PROBE_SAMPLE_RATE=0.01 in v1.3 default. v1.2 had probe_rate 0.002. effective 5x more probing.

sam: that matches numbers. more probing -> more attention_kernel_select CPU -> higher p95. kv hit rate drop could be due to timing/eviction pressure (probe tasks interfering with cache maintenance).

elaine: quick actions: 1) reduce PROBE_SAMPLE_RATE to 0.001 for rerank pool, 2) enable short-circuit for seq_len<32, 3) add a canary route to v1.2 while we validate. who owns?

maria: i'll submit the route change and env override for the pool.

jin: i'll prepare a small perf harness to reproduce with batch sizes [1,2,4,8,16,32,64] and dims 512/1024 and capture KV hit/miss and kernel_select time.

david: ops-bot, can you create a ticket?

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4921: "Investigate kernel_select probe rate regression affecting embeddings rerank" assigned to @jin, @maria. Link: https://redwood.ai/issue/INF-4921

sam: ping when route flipped. also add a trace id in headers so we can map token-level metrics to request IDs.

maria: route flipped at 2026-03-17T21:12:05Z to runtime:v1.2 for rerank (canary -> full for this pool). will watch metrics for 20m.

elaine: early numbers after flip: p95 token latency back to ~82ms, KV hit back to 90%, QPS steady. :thumbsup:

jin: great. still want the perf harness and a follow-up PR to make probe_rate adaptive (based on observed batch size distribution). I'll own the PR.

maria: follow-up items: (1) add token-phase panels to default per-route dashboard, (2) add a KV-sharding sanity alert if hit drops >10% in 10m, (3) make kernel_probe_rate config per-route.

david: please add those to INF-4921 and tag eng-runtime and eng-ml.

maria: done. INF-4921 updated with checklist and owners. closing this thread for now, we'll reopen if regression reappears.

sam: thanks everyone.
